correctness.rationale: Weighted-degree substitutions give a (L+1)-dimensional radial Jacobi block and (k-1) identical L-dimensional angular blocks, exactly matching the even and odd reflection sectors of the normalized path on 2L+1 vertices. Orthogonal direct sums establish the all-time operator-norm equality. Endpoint cyclicity and positivity of the zero mode convert path PGST, with no free phase, into operator-norm reflection. The 2022 full arXiv paper explicitly states the path PGST iff n=2^a+1, and the 2014 full arXiv paper proves path PST failure at n>=4. Direct spectral check gives P3 exact reversal at pi. Terminal splitting proves off-diagonal kernel factor 2v_iv_j. VERIFY.py tests finite weighted graph matrices independently; those tests are supporting, not universal proof.

value.rationale: The physically natural finite normalized-Laplacian spider implements a simultaneous k-channel Householder operation at all kL arm positions, with arbitrary prescribed positive conductance weights, exactly the same global approximation error as one simple path. The power-of-two cutoff and nonattainability beyond length one give a sharp architecture-level design criterion; all-time cross-channel amplitudes and optimal weighted probabilities are exact quantitative consequences. This is a structural all-parameter gate reduction, not a mere numerical sample or parameter renaming; no downstream paper-sized consequence is required.
